Method of Attack: Executing unauthorized code on Mazda MZD Connect infotainment system via USB flash drive insertion
Automatic execution of scripts on USB insertion without user interaction
Re-enabling SSH support on MZD Connect system
Potential installation of Remote Access Trojans (RATs)
Echoing outputs from *NIX commands through jci-dialog on infotainment system
Impacted Systems: Mazda cars with next-gen Mazda MZD Connect infotainment systems
Attack Vector: USB flash drive inserted into car's dashboard USB port
Indicators of Compromise: Execution of tweak.sh script via cmu_dataretrieval.up and dataRetrieval_config.txt
MZD Connect firmware version 59.00.502 fixes the USB code execution flaws
